summary: Bonner County, ID: a 20-foot pole platform from the 1930s, abandoned in the 1950s; the FFLA list marks it gone. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1950s and listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: 20-foot pole platform; sources give only the 1930s
Sources give only the 1950s; 1950 is the start of that decade

evidence.supports: about two miles south of Nordman
Idaho listing calls it a hike-in site
the other Lakeview is a separate lookout farther south

sources.title: Idaho lookout list, North Idaho Panhandle

notes_for_editor: Dates are decades only: a 1930s platform and a 1950s abandonment. The record's event years (1930 and 1950) are the start of each decade, not sourced years. Coordinates conflict in the record: FFLA 48.60573, -116.93708 vs Idaho Fire Lookouts 48.60531, -116.94938, about 900 m apart. No source read settles which is right, so the record location is unchanged. Staffing, access and the current site are not documented in the sources read. Height 6.1 m is taken from the 20-foot platform. The Forest Lookouts page for this site is titled Lakeview, not Lakeview (Wabaningo).
